prompt: Given a synthetic triangle mesh with one Basis and one relative shape key, create a read-only report checking that each key has the same vertex index count and list any mismatch. Do not change the mesh.
expected_behavior: Report basis/key vertex count agreement; preserve original mesh and source topology

prompt: Construct a tiny test scene with an armature and two bones in a private empty Blender scene; report world and armature rest matrices and verify their round-trip conversion. Avoid relying on bone names to infer anatomical semantics.
expected_behavior: Private scene only, no changes to imported skeleton, valid matrix-space round trip

prompt: For a synthetic mesh that already contains left_blink and right_blink shape keys, create a script that tests neutral, half and full influence and restores neutral values. Do not invent additional shape keys.
expected_behavior: All tested values restored; only existing synthetic keys touched; report executed states

prompt: Write a Blender Python test script for a private simple armature that samples neutral, +30-degree and -30-degree poses and reports finite transforms and restored neutral state. Do not modify original model or declare qualification.
expected_behavior: Explicit numeric results at each pose, no nonfinite transforms, neutral restoration
